questions.questionTextEn: Generally, where are coral reefs found?
questions.questionTextHi: [R.A.S./R.T.S.(Pre) 2008] Generally, where are coral reefs found?
optionsEn: Between Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn coastal areas
On both east and west coasts of continents and islands only
optionsHi: Between Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn coastal areas
On both east and west coasts of continents and islands only
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Between Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn coastal areas. Most of the world’s coral reefs are found at eastern and western coastal areas between the Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn (Generally expansion between 300N to 300S). Australia’s Great Barrier Reef is the world’s largest coral reef. Coral reefs cover 0.08% to 0.16% of our Oceans but they contain 25% of the world’s marine species. [R.A.S./R.T.S.(Pre) 2008]

questions.questionTextHi: [U.P. R.O./A.R.O. (Pre) 2023] With reference to the "Great Barrier Reef", which of the following statement/s is/are correct? 1. It is situated along the north-eastern coast of Australia. 2. It is more than 2500 kms in length. Select the correct answer using the code given below: Code :
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Only 1. The Great Barrier Reef is a site of remarkable variety and beauty on the north-east coast of Australia. Notably, it con- tains the world's largest collection of coral reefs, with 400 types of coral, 1500 species of fish and 4,000 types of mol- lusc. questions.questionTextEn: Consider the following statements : 1. Most of the world's coral reefs are in tropical waters. 2. More than one-third of the world's coral reefs are located in the territories of Australia, Indonesia and Philippines. 3. Coral reefs host far more number of animal phyla than those hosted by tropical rainforests. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2018] Consider the following statements : 1. Most of the world's coral reefs are in tropical waters. 2. More than one-third of the world's coral reefs are located in the territories of Australia, Indonesia and Philippines. 3. Coral reefs host far more number of animal phyla than those hosted by tropical rainforests. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) 1, 2 and 3. Coral reefs are formed by the consolidation and combina- tion of the skeletons of marine organisms, coral or coral polyps. Significanly, coral reefs generally are confi ned to tropical and semi-tropical waters (Mostly 25 0N to 25 0S). Somewhere its expansion is 300N to 300S. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2018]
